correctness.rationale: The exact full-draw missed-set model has N=binom(m,c), M=binom(m-1,c-1), omission q=c/m, and falling-factorial moments (N)_r((M)_r/(N)_r)^t. Negatively correlated label omissions give Var U_t<=E U_t. Uniform Stirling for c~log m yields log E U_(c+1)=delta-0.5 log(2pi)+o(1); fixed factorial moments imply Poisson(e^x/sqrt(2pi)). At c and c+2 Chebyshev and Markov leave a two-round law. The tail sum bound (c+1)/mu_c+mu_(c+1)q/(1-q) tends to zero even for delta->+-infinity with delta=o(log m), and star finishes after c+1 distinct centers with expectation c+1+O(c^2/m). Formula and scope reconstruct correctly. Finite moment computation for N=6,M=3,t=3,r=2 is exactly 6/25. This arithmetic check is not an infinite proof.
